Messages.Author: Madman
Messages.Body:
Folks:

Horrid Form says:
Only usable before range is chosen. This vampire gets +1 strength for the
remainder of combat.

SUP: As above, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage each round for the
remainder of combat.

I presume that I could play multiple Horrid Forms at once (that is, combat
cards are generally stackable). Correct?? If so, this card is quite a bit
more powerful than I had earlier suspected.

Let me know, O Rules Gurus!

And thanks,
Madman
